ruleDefinitions.name: User Discovery And Export Via Get-ADUser Cmdlet - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the Get-ADUser cmdlet to collect user information and output it to a file Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-ADUser\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-Filter\\ \\*.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\>\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\|\\ Select\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Out\\-File.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-Content.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Add\\-Content.*")))
